question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing left winger, Dave is playing right winger, and Eve is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) right midfielder
(C) left winger
(D) right winger
(E) benchwarmer
solution:
Each row lists positions in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: goalkeeper, right midfielder, left winger, right winger, benchwarmer.
After Dave–Alice: right winger, right midfielder, left winger, goalkeeper, benchwarmer.
After Dave–Claire: right winger, right midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger, benchwarmer.
After Bob–Dave: right winger, left winger, goalkeeper, right midfielder, benchwarmer.
After Claire–Eve: right winger, left winger, benchwarmer, right midfielder, goalkeeper.
After Bob–Claire: right winger, benchwarmer, left winger, right midfielder, goalkeeper.
Claire is the left winger, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
